exact_response: Yes. Indigenous people should be free to reject racial labels that don’t reflect how they understand themselves, and to describe their identity through their nation, community, culture, ancestry, or other terms they choose. Indigenous identity can also involve political status and collective belonging, which racial categories alone don’t capture.
